name: Battery protection controller
summary: A battery protection controller monitors selected limits and requests protective action when its conditions are reached.
description: A battery protection controller monitors selected limits and requests protective action when its conditions are reached.
A pack can disconnect its output after a monitored fault is detected.

Use separate labels for sensing a problem and disconnecting the battery. The protection controller checks selected conditions, while a switch or contactor carries out the required interruption.
